description: Synthesise speech in a reference voice using F5-TTS. Requires a Python interpreter with the f5-tts and soundfile packages. You MUST supply a reference audio sample and its transcript — there is no built-in voice.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

device.description: Compute device for F5-TTS: cpu, cuda, mps. Default: cpu.

pythonBin.description: Optional absolute path to a Python interpreter with F5-TTS installed.

refAudio.description: Absolute path to the reference audio sample (required).

text.description: Text to speak in the cloned voice. Keep it short (~15 words) for best quality.

name: media_voice_clone
